svg.title: Brightdesk Office Suite Home
svg.desc: A unified Brightdesk Home screen combining local recent work, useful shortcuts and the ten original product icons. A professional navigation rail links Home, My Apps and Files, with suite Settings in the top-right.
svg.text: Your documents, data and projects — together in one place.
What would you like to work on?
Jump straight into a document, spreadsheet, presentation or idea.
Bring documents, data, stories and plans
together with the right Brightdesk tools.
Ten focused tools, connected by one Brightdesk experience.
